import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long flow, capacity;
        Edge(int src, int dst, long flow, long capacity) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static class FlowGraph {
        int source_id, sink_id;
        List<Edge> edge_list;
        List<Integer>[] adj;
        int[] depth;
        int[] next_edge;
        int MAX_VERTEX;

        FlowGraph(int maxVertex) {
            MAX_VERTEX = maxVertex;
            edge_list = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new List[MAX_VERTEX];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VERTEX; ++i) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            depth = new int[MAX_VERTEX];
            next_edge = new int[MAX_VERTEX];
        }

        void clear_all() {
            edge_list.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VERTEX; ++i) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edge_list.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            edge_list.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            adj[u].add(edge_list.size() - 2);
            adj[v].add(edge_list.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs_level() {
            Arrays.fill(depth, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.push(source_id);
            depth[source_id] = 0;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edge_list.get(idx);
                    if (e.capacity > e.flow && depth[e.dst] == -1) {
                        depth[e.dst] = depth[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return depth[sink_id] != -1;
        }

        long dfs_flow(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == sink_id || flow == 0) return flow;
            long total_pushed = 0;
            for (int i = next_edge[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                next_edge[u] = i;
                int idx = adj[u].get(i);
                Edge e = edge_list.get(idx);
                if (depth[e.dst] == depth[u] + 1 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    long pushed = dfs_flow(e.dst, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        edge_list.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                        total_pushed += pushed;
                        flow -= pushed;
                        if (flow == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return total_pushed;
        }

        long compute_max_flow() {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs_level()) {
                Arrays.fill(next_edge, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs_flow(source_id, Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static FlowGraph fg;
    static char[][][] board = new char[2][15][15];
    static boolean[][] visited_coord = new boolean[15][15];
    static int[][] time_cost = new int[15][15];
    static int grid_size, max_time;
    static int[] target_vertex = new int[103];

    static void bfs_from_start(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(time_cost[i], 111);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        time_cost[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});

        int[] dr = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dc = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur[0], c = cur[1], d = cur[2];
            if (visited_coord[r][c]) continue;
            visited_coord[r][c] = true;
            time_cost[r][c] = d;

            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dr[i], nc = c + dc[i];
                if (nr >= 1 && nr <= grid_size && nc >= 1 && nc <= grid_size &&
                    !visited_coord[nr][nc] && board[0][nr][nc] != 'Y') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc, d + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int encode_node(int level, int r, int c) {
        return level * grid_size * grid_size + (r - 1) * grid_size + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        grid_size = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        max_time = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            board[0][i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            board[1][i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        fg = new FlowGraph(7100);
        fg.source_id = 0;
        fg.sink_id = 7098;

        int start_r = 0, start_c = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; ++j) {
                if (board[0][i][j] == 'Z') {
                    start_r = i;
                    start_c = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size * grid_size; ++i) {
            target_vertex[i] = 7097 - (grid_size * grid_size - i);
        }

        bfs_from_start(start_r, start_c);

        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_size; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(board[0][i][j])) {
                    fg.connect(fg.source_id, encode_node(0, i, j), board[0][i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(board[1][i][j])) {
                    fg.connect(target_vertex[encode_node(0, i, j)], fg.sink_id, board[1][i][j] - '0');
                }
                fg.connect(encode_node(0, i, j), target_vertex[encode_node(0, i, j)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
            }
        }

        int[] dr = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dc = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        for (int t = 1; t <= max_time; ++t) {
            for (int r = 1; r <= grid_size; ++r) {
                for (int c = 1; c <= grid_size; ++c) {
                    if (board[0][r][c] == 'Y' || board[0][r][c] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nr = r + dr[d], nc = c + dc[d];
                        if (nr >= 1 && nr <= grid_size && nc >= 1 && nc <= grid_size &&
                            board[0][nr][nc] != 'Y' && board[0][nr][nc] != 'Z' &&
                            time_cost[r][c] >= t && time_cost[nr][nc] >= t) {
                            fg.connect(encode_node(t - 1, nr, nc), encode_node(t, r, c), Long.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                    fg.connect(encode_node(t, r, c), target_vertex[encode_node(0, r, c)], Long.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(fg.compute_max_flow());
    }
}
